narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I say he should press plus three again, because adding more fixes the mistake.
<bookmark mark='higher'/>But another plus three takes the lift to floor plus six, even higher than before.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Going higher never brings him back, so the next press must go the other way.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Moving the same number of floors the other way cancels a press.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Joseph is on the ground floor and presses minus two by mistake. What should he press to cancel it?
